characters.name: Alok
characters.introEn: An active aura ability described by Garena as healing and movement support for Alok and nearby allies.
characters.introHi: Active aura ability jo Garena ke mutabik Alok aur nearby allies ko healing aur movement support deti hai.
currentEn: Creates an aura that affects Alok and allies within its area.
Awakened Party Remix adds music-note interactions to the ability.
Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
currentHi: Aura Alok aur uske area ke andar allies ko affect karti hai.
Awakened Party Remix ability mein music-note interactions add karta hai.
Multiple Drop the Beat auras stack nahi hoti.
notesEn: OB54 introduced Battle Royale Skill Boost choices for Alok. The exact boost values are not reproduced in this profile.
OB53 documents an interaction rule for overlapping Alok abilities.
notesHi: OB54 mein Alok ke liye Battle Royale Skill Boost choices introduce hui. Exact boost values is profile mein reproduce nahi ki gayi hain.
OB53 mein overlapping Alok abilities ka interaction rule document hua hai.

awakened.introEn: Awakened version of Drop the Beat with music-note interactions.
awakened.introHi: Drop the Beat ka awakened version jisme music-note interactions hain.
currentEn: The awakened variant drops music notes while the aura is active.
Teammates can interact with the notes to receive the ability's support effect.
currentHi: Aura active hone par awakened variant music notes drop karta hai.
Teammates notes ke saath interact karke ability ka support effect le sakte hain.

historyEn: OB45: Party Remix music-note mechanics documented.
historyHi: OB45: Party Remix music-note mechanics document hui.

Late-2023 official patch notes mein later ability adjustment document hai.

characters.name: Antonio
characters.introEn: A passive ability that grants additional Shield Points at the start of a match, as described in Garena's official notes.
characters.introHi: Passive ability jo match ke start par additional Shield Points deti hai, jaisa Garena ke official notes mein describe hai.
currentEn: Grants additional Shield Points at match start.
Shield Points are a separate defensive resource and are consumed before HP.
Garena's Shield Points notes describe limitations on which damage types they protect against.
currentHi: Match start par additional Shield Points milte hain.
Shield Points ek separate defensive resource hain aur HP se pehle consume hote hain.
Garena ke Shield Points notes kuch damage types ke against protection limitations describe karte hain.
notesEn: The Shield Points system is documented separately from armor damage-reduction effects.
The official notes describe environmental-damage limitations for Shield Points.
notesHi: Shield Points system armor damage-reduction effects se alag document kiya gaya hai.
Official notes Shield Points ke liye environmental-damage limitations describe karte hain.
historyHi: OB41: Shield Points rework document hua.
OB43: Shield Points adjustment document hua.
OB48: Antonio ka latest documented adjustment.

hiddenMechanics.text: Official Shield Points notes state that Shield Points are not affected by armor damage-reduction effects and do not cover certain environmental damage.
